en: A black‑and‑white maritime view showing several tall-masted sailing ships and a side‑wheel or river-style steamship emitting a large plume of smoke. The steamship appears to be towing or passing close by a sailing vessel. Additional masts and wharves are visible in the distance along a low shoreline. The overall look is of an early harbor or port scene, likely from the transition era between sail and steam.
